03-social-media-platform-strategies.md.title: Social Media Platform Strategies
03-social-media-platform-strategies.md.description: Module 02 — Content Marketing, Social Media & Influencer Strategy | Topic 3 --- Not all social media platforms are equal. Each one has a different audience, algorithm, content format, and purpose. A carousel that works on Instagram will flop on YouTube. A thread that trends on X will get zero reach on Facebook. Your job as a social media marketer is to understand where your audience lives and what content format works on that platform. > Fun...

04-influencer-marketing.md.title: Influencer Marketing
04-influencer-marketing.md.description: Module 02 — Content Marketing, Social Media & Influencer Strategy | Topic 4 --- Influencer marketing is partnering with people who have a loyal, engaged audience to promote your brand. Instead of the brand telling you "buy our product," someone you already follow and trust says "I use this product and I love it." Think of it like word-of-mouth marketing at scale. When your friend recommends a restaurant, you trust them more than a TV ad....
